mechanism: Azithromycin may increase risk of QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias, and both drugs can cause renal impairment and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that potentiate cardiac toxicity.
action: Monitor cardiac function, electrolytes (particularly magnesium and calcium), and renal function; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusion.
